name: Plateau tea
summary: Tea from the plateau hills, from older plantings and newer oolong, drunk at the Moc Suong tea ground.
origin: Tân Lập and Mộc Sương. Vietnam Tourism, and Bao Son La, 26 December 2019.
howToEat: Drink it at the tea ground, in daylight.

The 2019 feature says Moc Chau tea is less famous than Thai Nguyen tea. Vietnam Tourism’s older line that calls the hills the largest tea region is not settled by that feature. The drink is the cup either way.
Do not reuse the 2019 line that the hills charged no ticket.
where: Tân Lập for the rows. Mộc Sương for the processing visit and the ceremony. Bao Son La’s 2016 feature also lists chè among foods to carry home.
